import unittest

from solution import snapshot_layers


class SnapshotLayersTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_order_extra_keys_and_empty(self):
        layers = [
            {"name": "base", "settings": {"color": "blue"}, "ignored": 1},
            {"name": "top", "settings": {"visible": True}},
        ]
        result = snapshot_layers(layers)
        self.assertEqual(result, {
            "base": {"color": "blue"},
            "top": {"visible": True},
        })
        self.assertEqual(tuple(result), ("base", "top"))
        self.assertEqual(snapshot_layers([]), {})

    def test_outer_and_entry_type_errors(self):
        for layers in (None, (), {}):
            with self.subTest(layers=layers), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                snapshot_layers(layers)
        for entry in (None, [], "layer"):
            with self.subTest(entry=entry), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                snapshot_layers([entry])

    def test_missing_malformed_and_duplicate_data(self):
        cases = [
            [{}],
            [{"name": "x"}],
            [{"settings": {}}],
            [{"name": "", "settings": {}}],
            [{"name": 1, "settings": {}}],
            [{"name": "x", "settings": []}],
            [{"name": "x", "settings": {}}, {"name": "x", "settings": {"a": 1}}],
        ]
        for layers in cases:
            with self.subTest(layers=layers), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                snapshot_layers(layers)

    def test_deep_independence_from_input_and_between_values(self):
        shared = {"nested": [[]]}
        layers = [
            {"name": "one", "settings": shared},
            {"name": "two", "settings": shared},
        ]
        result = snapshot_layers(layers)
        self.assertIsNot(result["one"], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(result["two"], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(result["one"], result["two"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["one"]["nested"], result["two"]["nested"])
        result["one"]["nested"][0].append(1)
        self.assertEqual(result["two"], {"nested": [[]]})
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"nested": [[]]})
        shared["nested"][0].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result["two"], {"nested": [[]]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
